author: worker-l2-adapter
mode: SOURCE-LEVEL CONTRACT EXTRACTION. LOCAL ONLY. No canonical edits, no console, no execution. Every status is evidence-cited; nothing here is a claim of in-game capability beyond the cited evidence.

layer_model.L1_compatibility_runtime: The UE4SS-ps5 port + Lua VM + composition/packaging substrate (the 368-unit composed runtime, PRX candidate, loader). Reused as-is by a second game.
layer_model.L2_engine_adapter: THIS CONTRACT. The interface boundary between the game profile (L3) and the compatibility runtime (L1): what L3 must supply (input surface), what L1 provides to mods and to the diagnostics/acceptance system (output surface), and the lifecycle + failure naming both sides share.
layer_model.L3_game_profile: Per-title/per-title-update data: identity + activation declaration, captured executable + geometry, seed constants + derivations, engine-version pins + layout INIs, loadlist/mod set, pad binding profile, spawn-rung addresses. Today instantiated by worker-2-layout-facts/profiles/townfall-ps5-ue56.profile.json + the v3 staged package + SEED-TABLE.json.
layer_model.L4_game_mod: The game-specific Lua mod (TownfallItemSpawner main.lua + UEHelpers.lua). Consumer of the L2 output surface; not part of this contract but its acceptance oracle (FAILURE-TAXONOMY.md) is referenced.

status_vocabulary.DELIVERED-VERIFIED: Implemented in the composed candidate AND executed in the real game process with recorded evidence (launch-8/launch-9/probe sessions).
status_vocabulary.DELIVERED-HOST-ONLY: Implemented, host-compiled/host-tested/composed into a candidate PRX (static checks), staged or staged-adjacent, but that element has never executed in the game process.
status_vocabulary.IN-FLIGHT: A named worker/edition is actively converging this element with a defined next gate.
status_vocabulary.GAP: Not implemented, or proven not composable, or structurally impossible in the current candidate.

input_surface.description: What L3 (the game profile/activation) must hand L2 before and during startup. Every element is a hard, validated boundary: wrong or missing input = a named loud refusal, never a guessed address.

elements.name: title match
elements.requirement: Activated mods carry the exact expected title (PS5 title id, e.g. PPSA33286); mismatch refuses startup.
elements.in_game_evidence: launch-9 activation consumed; supplier plugin passed path validation + roots (L9E)

elements.name: framework request
elements.requirement: Activation must declare engine 'unreal' + framework 'ue4ss-ps5'; refusal 'Activation does not request the native UE4SS framework'.

elements.name: file role filter
elements.requirement: Only roles lua_mod/config/script accepted; others refuse 'Unsupported UE4SS activation file role'.

elements.name: preload requirement
elements.requirement: Every startup file must be preloaded into the activation snapshot; 0-byte enabled.txt must preload with a non-null data pointer; refusal 'UE4SS file was not preloaded: <path>'.

elements.name: logical key layout
elements.requirement: Files surface as logical keys under ue4ss/ : ue4ss/UE4SS-settings.ini, ue4ss/MemberVariableLayout.ini, ue4ss/VTableLayout.ini, ue4ss/PS5Pad.ini, ue4ss/Mods/<Name>/Scripts/main.lua, ue4ss/Mods/<Name>/enabled.txt, ue4ss/Mods/shared/<Name>/<Name>.lua. No filesystem scan exists on this platform.

seed_slots.policy: Offline-derived per title-update against the sha-pinned capture; under-determined slot stays unseeded and blocks startup loudly. Identity/ABI class labeled exactly like candidate provenance ('identity and ABI unverified') until the per-slot validator accrues in-game evidence. Required-mask shape A (launch-10): all four REQUIRED seeds {0,2,3,4} must be present or startup refuses; slot 6 handled by settings; slot 10 optional (vtable fallback).

elements.name: slot 0 g_uobject_array
elements.validation_class: permits_pointer_slot (readable + 8-aligned via registered lease) + optional bounded 96-byte header-plausibility probe under trusted vmmap; non-fatal
elements.in_game_evidence: the only REQUIRED slot with live structural validation: zcode_anchor_validation_RESULTS (layout A, 0x97ba110, 71959 objects, read+write) + igf6 promotion; GC-order predicate re-validated (worker-predicate-gc-fix)

elements.name: slot 2 fname_ctor_wchar
elements.validation_class: code address: NO data-side validation exists; flows around mapped admission (permits_code G4 bypass); FC-1 in-game probe staged (64-byte prologue read + 9/9 call-site windows re-decode, fail-closed) but NOT yet executed

elements.name: slot 3 gmalloc
elements.validation_class: data pointer slot; V1 qword@seed==global-instance-addr + V2 qword@instance==RELRO-vtable chain, arms only if V1+V2 pass, else loud PostInitialize throw 'GMalloc is uninitialized.'

elements.name: slot 4 static_construct_object_internal
elements.validation_class: code address; igf4-style sco_anchor check (mprotect-first gated 16-byte read vs retained-image expected bytes) DESIGN ONLY; in-game byte-confirmation blocked (exec-only text)

elements.name: slot 6 engine_version
elements.validation_class: settings-provisioned: [EngineVersionOverride] MajorVersion/MinorVersion installs a no-op version_finder ScanOverride, removes bit 6 from the required mask; S2 layout gate is the downstream correctness witness
elements.current_value_townfall_ps5: 5.6 (v3 ini + profile pin, origin 'engine_version status=0 major=5 minor=6')

elements.name: slot 10 gameengine_tick (OPTIONAL)
elements.semantic: UGameEngine::Tick; deliberately NOT seeded on launch-10
elements.validation_class: vtable fallback: live-object vptr read (RW data) + vtable entry read (R-- data) + Zydis thunk decode at target (exec-page data read, igf6 crash class); scan miss falls back to vtable loudly
elements.current_value_townfall_ps5: runtime 0x33ac8c0 = base 0x400000 + linked 0x2fac8c0; canonical prologue byte-verified in sha-pinned eboot 3b6cfad4
elements.note: oracle F29 prints the live vtable value at launch-10; runtime confirmation supersedes static identity

settings_keys.policy: Consumed ONLY from the logical activation key; missing file = hard throw; NUL = hard throw; ModsFolderPath/ControllingModsTxt refused under native activation; unlisted keys keep code defaults. v3 key set (13 keys) fully parsed with zero key drift (MLR).

elements.name: [General] SecondsToScanBeforeGivingUp
elements.admission: default coerced 30->120; bounds the scan loop, throw 'PS scan timed out'

elements.name: [General] DefaultExecuteInGameThreadMethod
elements.admission: selects the m_engine_tick_actions drain path used by every main.lua callback (PROG:1494)

elements.name: [General] DefaultFNameToStringMethod
elements.admission: Scan route + Kismet Conv_NameToString fallback retained; live proof pending

elements.name: [Debug] ConsoleEnabled / GuiConsoleEnabled / GuiConsoleVisible
elements.admission: native services gate: any enabled console would hard-throw at ctor (PROG:728-757)

elements.name: [Debug] RenderMode
elements.admission: any other RenderMode hard-throws at ctor

elements.name: [CrashDump] EnableDumping
elements.admission: native services gate hard throw if enabled

elements.name: [EngineVersionOverride] MajorVersion / MinorVersion
elements.admission: both != -1 and in uint32 range else throw '...must be in range of a uint32'; sets Unreal::Version::Major/Minor + no-op version_finder ScanOverride; parser effective bound is int32 (get_int64 via 32-bit stoi, host-measured)

elements.name: [Hooks] HookProcessInternal / HookProcessLocalScriptFunction
elements.admission: both must be 0: the SINI:1497 gate is (bHookProcessInternal || bHookProcessLocalScriptFunction) and the sub-derivation does not re-check its flag, so either key left 1 keeps init-time ExecuteUbergraph FuncPtr jmp-resolve + 164-byte Zydis reads against game text; the only consumer is the custom-events script hook, silently not installed when both are 0 (no else branch)

elements.name: hook defaults (unset in v3, must stay TRUE)
elements.admission: mod-load-critical hooks keep defaults; ProcessEvent resolves from the vtable (readpath-guard UI:1932-1938)

elements.name: ue4ss/PS5Pad.ini profile
elements.requirement: Read once during backend ctor from the mod source; absent file = no pad bridge (start continues); present+failing provider = runtime start throws. Syntax: [PS5Pad] User = -1 (first logged-in user) or id; [Bindings] CHORD = MODIFIERS+KEY; ASCII only; at most 128 bindings; no chord may contain another configured chord; all parse errors are hard refusals with line numbers. Buttons: L3 R3 OPTIONS UP RIGHT DOWN LEFT L2 R2 L1 R1 TRIANGLE CIRCLE CROSS SQUARE TOUCH_PAD; Keys: exact UE4SS KeyDef names; Modifiers SHIFT CONTROL ALT.
elements.v3_mapping: OPTIONS->F7, UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT->arrows, CROSS->RETURN (exactly the 6 keys main.lua registers)

elements.name: context.input_source
elements.requirement: Handler init from context.input_source during ctor validate_native_services; throws 'Input registration unavailable' without an active source. PS5Pad.ini conflicts with a supplied native input source ('PS5Pad.ini conflicts with the supplied native input source'). Provider factory returning no source or unavailable phase/error throws.

elements.name: hardware provider (scePad backend)
elements.requirement: PS5PadNative backend: scePad*/sceUserService* import set; eager open; already-initialized 0x80960003 accepted; duplicate-timestamp suppression; baseline swallow; disconnect clears. First hardware contact designed to be the standalone probe PRX (padp-79947e016dfe, frozen), NOT the composed runtime.
elements.in_game_evidence: NONE - probe built and frozen, runbook staged, no console run claimed

elements.name: configured roots (Resolution B)
elements.requirement: game_executable_path hard gate: absolute, normalized, has filename, existing regular file, file_size ok (ValidateNativeProgramContext NPC:85-100). In-game verified in launch-9 (no Resolution-B failures).

elements.name: vmmap walk + frozen capture
elements.requirement: sysctl KERN_PROC_VMMAP walk (structsize-respecting) produces the trusted span snapshot; the bridge's first op capture() freezes it; ALL registration and lease derivation read the FROZEN snapshot (r14 L1-L5 removes the two-snapshot race that caused launch-8's code=2 throw).

elements.name: read-lease registry
elements.requirement: Readable spans registered from the frozen snapshot with true protection (R|X never W; exec/gap pages never); cap 128 regions (bridge_lease_cap); anchor reads gated on the registry; any uncoverable derivable lease range refuses LOUDLY BEFORE any lease exists: runtime_start_failed code=1 detail='lease coverage gap: requested [lo,lo+len) outside registered readable spans; nearest registered [b..e)' (MRS_ERR_CONVERSION, no lmf events on that path).
elements.expected_shape: bridge_lease_reg_spans=6, bridge_lease_reg=6 on the pinned igf3 shape (BR:675-695)
elements.status: DELIVERED-VERIFIED (registration ran in launch-9 spans=6/reg=6) / DELIVERED-HOST-ONLY (r14 hardening)

elements.name: spanpub publication
elements.requirement: Non-image readable spans published to the runtime, <= kMaxPublishedSpans=16, with truncation-honest envelope markers: bridge_spanpub_count / bridge_spanpub_total / bridge_spanpub_cap / bridge_spanpub_env_low / bridge_spanpub_env_high (BR:982-986 call, :736-740 emissions).
elements.note: the AS-BUILT fc06fe52 TU failed packaging compile; the five tags are prediction-pinned in the oracle, not yet live-evidenced; the repaired bridge 663e7ce9 in launch10-final-b carries them

elements.name: image extent law
elements.requirement: runtime extent = [base, base+kImageExtentVaddr); kImageExtentVaddr=0xbc602c8 for FILE vaddrs (uniform slide = file + 0x400000); 0xfc602c8 is the known-wrong 60MiB-biased launch-8 clamp, never reuse. Whole-extent consumer reads are refused; extent is bounded by the capture snapshot.

tick_pump.name: RegisterEngineTickPreCallback(HookedEngineTick, {GameThreadInitializer})

tick_pump.role: IsInGameThreadRaw() gate -> process_simple_actions(m_engine_tick_actions) -> process_delayed_actions; a PURE Lua VM drain (lua_pcall); needs NO ProcessEvent

tick_pump.name: QueryHarness::Global().InstallDefaultEngineBindings()
tick_pump.role: binds the 4 engine seams exactly once BEFORE RuntimeOwner::start: IsGameThreadInitialized / IsInGameThreadRaw / GetGameThreadIdRaw / UObjectArray::GetNumElements; host builds refuse the default binding outright

tick_pump.name: R3 FuncPtr-marshal pump (launch-11 primary)
tick_pump.role: R3MarshalPumpPending / R3MarshalPublishGameThreadIdentity / R3MarshalQueryHarnessDispatch bridges; marshal-first enqueue ladder so a refused detour arm never loses a queued closure
tick_pump.status: IN-FLIGHT (enqueue-ladder fix staged+host-tested, NOT composed; marshal-consumer linkage delivered, integration in flight)

execute_ingamethread_enqueue_drain.name: enqueue (calling thread)
execute_ingamethread_enqueue_drain.role: make_hook_state + luaL_ref + m_engine_tick_actions.emplace_back(SimpleLuaAction) under m_thread_actions_mutex (or m_pending_engine_tick_actions mid-drain); enqueue touches NOTHING engine-side; throw sites precede the mutex so a throw loses the closure (the l11-enqueue-ladder bug, fix staged)

execute_ingamethread_enqueue_drain.name: drain (game thread, per tick)
execute_ingamethread_enqueue_drain.role: swap vector out under mutex; per action get_function_ref + lua_pcall; partial stall impossible at queue level (all six mod callbacks share one queue)

stages.name: module_start / activation
stages.steps: mfa_activate returns valid activation (title matched, files preloaded) -> StartActivatedRuntimeWithAck builds RuntimeAckConfig (pid, CLOCK_MONOTONIC ms, status_root = exact mfa_config::root) -> InstallDefaultEngineBindings (4 engine seams, once, before the init thread) -> PrepareActivatedUE4SSRuntime -> MakeActivatedUE4SSModSource -> RuntimeAckSink::Open(<status_root>/runtime-status.txt)
stages.ack: activated written once the buffered inventory (deferred native mod startup incl.) also succeeded; preparation-time failure -> ack failed(1, what) then rethrow

stages.name: RuntimeOwner start (init thread)
stages.steps: owner->start() spawns the serialized init thread; RuntimeState Prepared->Starting->EngineInitialized; double start impossible (entry_guard); stop() never joins from its own initializer
stages.status: DELIVERED-VERIFIED (state machine exercised in-game through failed/activated paths)

stages.name: engine bootstrap (ScanGame/PostInitialize)
stages.steps: program ctor (native services gate; validate context; Handler input init from PS5Pad.ini) -> start_native_mods (cpp mods, m_native_mods_started) -> init thread: Initialize(Config) -> seed arming gate (SHAPE A: all four REQUIRED seeds present, else '[Seeds] Required-slot seed table incomplete' refusal) -> SeedArming::consume_required_slot_seeds (read-path-guarded binds: slots 0/1/3 DataReadable-only, 2/4 CodeCallOnly bind-only) -> GMalloc V1/V2 chain -> ps_scan arm skipped/short-circuited when seeds armed -> consumer assignments (SetupGUObjectArrayAddress, FName ctor, GMalloc, SCO) -> LoadMap vtable walk -> Tick vtable fallback (TickInternal.is_ready TRUE) -> pump arms (HookedEngineTick + QueryHarness dispatch) -> PostInitialize (required objects) -> InitializeVersionedContainer -> PublishStagedNativeLayoutMaps + ArmLayoutGate
stages.deadline: StartupWait 5 minutes ('Unreal initialization cancelled' / 'Unreal initialization startup deadline exceeded') + SecondsToScanBeforeGivingUp ('PS scan timed out')
stages.status: DELIVERED-HOST-ONLY (composed in candidate; never reached in-game - launch-9 both refusals upstream)

stages.name: engine-ready + mods-started ack
stages.steps: real on_engine_initialized callback -> ack engine_ready; if mods_startup_verified_ (ctor start_native_mods succeeded) also ack mods_started; NOTE: mods_started certifies INVENTORY, not script execution - the '[Lua] Loaded' line is the mod-executed oracle

stages.name: event loop + Lua mods
stages.steps: event loop jthread UE4SSProgram::update (~5ms cadence) -> on_program_start once (PROSPERO shutdown check) -> ShouldRunNativeModCallbacks(true, m_native_mods_started) -> install_lua_mods -> LuaMod::on_program_start -> start_lua_mods -> start_mods<LuaMod> -> LuaMod::start_mod -> load_and_execute_script(main.lua) -> '[Lua] [TownfallItemSpawner] Loaded v1.0...' oracle
stages.status: DELIVERED-HOST-ONLY (a synthetic Lua VM did execute lua_load/lua_call in-game inside the launch-9 entry harness - first fully-green in-game harness - but the mod chain itself never ran)

stages.name: tick loop + input
stages.steps: game's real GameEngine::Tick runs through the detour: (1) HookedEngineTick publishes NativeGameThreadIdentity on first tick then RemoveSelf; (2) QueryHarnessEngineTickDispatch witness; (3) engine_tick_hook drains m_engine_tick_actions when IsInGameThreadRaw(); pad polled every ~5ms in Handler::process_event; RegisterKeyBind callbacks fire synchronously on the UE4SS UpdateThread and defer bodies via ExecuteInGameThread
stages.status: DELIVERED-HOST-ONLY (never reached in-game; decided by launch-10 F29/FLAG-1 verdicts)

stages.name: stop / failure
stages.steps: request_stop -> program request_shutdown -> join -> stopped ack (at most one further line); any throw on any stage -> catch -> failed(code, sanitized what) -> rethrow preserved; RuntimeOwner destructor never detaches (terminate if stop fails)
stages.status: DELIVERED-VERIFIED (failed paths observed in-game launch-8/9; stopped path host-only)
